arxiv-2002-03638.title: Piecewise quadratic growth during the 2019 novel coronavirus epidemic
arxiv-2002-03638.creator: Axel Brandenburg
arxiv-2002-03638.description: Abstract The temporal growth in the number of deaths in the COVID-19 epidemic is subexponential. Here we show that a piecewise quadratic law provides an excellent fit during the thirty days after the first three fatalities on January 20 and later since the end of March 2020. There is also a brief intermediate period of exponential growth.

arxiv-2011-13288.creator: I. Mardor, S. Ayet San Andrés, T. Dickel, D. Amanbayev, S. Beck, J. Bergmann, H. Geissel, L. Gröf, E. Haettner, C. Hornung, N. Kalantar-Nayestanaki, G. Kripko-Koncz, I. arxiv-2011-13288.description: Abstract Mass measurements of the nuclides 69 As, 70,71 Se and 71 Br, produced via fragmentation of a 124 Xe primary beam at the FRS at GSI, have been performed with the multiple-reflection time-of-flight mass spectrometer (MR-TOF-MS) of the FRS Ion Catcher with an unprecedented mass resolving power of almost 1,000,000.

arxiv-2111-15089.title: X-ray and Radio Studies of the candidate Millisecond Pulsar Binary 4FGL J0935.3+0901
arxiv-2111-15089.creator: Dong Zheng, Zhong-Xiang Wang, Yi Xing, Jithesh Vadakkumthani
arxiv-2111-15089.description: Abstract 4FGL J0935.5+0901, a γ \gamma -ray source recently identified as a candidate redback-type millisecond pulsar binary (MSP), shows an interesting feature of having double-peaked emission lines in its optical spectrum. The feature would further suggest the source as a transitional MSP system in the sub-luminous disk state.

arxiv-2208-03021.title: Family of New Binary Transition Metal Nitrides Superconductors
arxiv-2208-03021.creator: Zheng-Wei Liao, Xin-Wei Yi, Jing-Yang You, Bo Gu, Gang Su
arxiv-2208-03021.description: Abstract Superconductivity in transition metal nitrides (TMNs) has been investigated for a long time, such as zirconium nitride (ZrN) with a superconducting transition temperature Tc of 10 K. Recently, a phase diagram has been revealed in ZrN x with different nitrogen concentrations, which is very similar to that of high-temperature copper oxide superconductors.

arxiv-2307-05634.title: Hyperspherical Embedding for Point Cloud Completion
arxiv-2307-05634.creator: Junming Zhang, Haomeng Zhang, Ram Vasudevan, Matthew Johnson-Roberson
arxiv-2307-05634.description: Abstract Most real-world 3D measurements from depth sensors are incomplete, and to address this issue the point cloud completion task aims to predict the complete shapes of objects from partial observations. Previous works often adapt an encoder-decoder architecture, where the encoder is trained to extract embeddings that are used as inputs to generate predictions from the decoder.

arxiv-2309-00734.title: On the Onset of Coherent Phonon Motion in Peierls-Distorted Antimony by Attosecond Transient Absorption
arxiv-2309-00734.creator: Lorenz Drescher, Bethany R. de Roulet, Yoong Sheng Phang, Stephen R. Leone
arxiv-2309-00734.description: Abstract Attosecond extreme-ultraviolet (XUV) transient absorption spectroscopy measurements on the Peierls-distorted phase of the semimetal antimony (Sb) are presented. After excitation by an ultrashort, broad band near-infrared (NIR) pulse, the distortion is (partly) lifted causing the well-known coherent phonon motion of the lattice.

arxiv-2505-19279.title: First Demonstration of Resonant Pitch-Angle Scattering of Relativistic Electrons by Externally-Launched Helicon Waves
arxiv-2505-19279.creator: H. Choudhury, A. Battey, C. Paz-Soldan, J. Lestz, N. Leuthold, A. Lvovskiy, C. Marini, J. Barr, W. Heidbrink, D. Spong, S. Tang, B. Van Compernolle, Q. Zhang, Y. Zhang, X. Tang
arxiv-2505-19279.description: Abstract Helicon waves satisfying the normal wave-particle cyclotron resonance are observed to limit the growth and maximum energy of relativistic electrons (REs) in low-density Ohmic DIII-D tokamak plasmas. Following the application of helicon waves, pitch-angle scattering of high-energy REs causes an increase in both synchrotron and electron-cyclotron emissions.

arxiv-2508-03170.title: Quantum Spectral Reasoning: A Non-Neural Architecture for Interpretable Machine Learning
arxiv-2508-03170.creator: Andrew Kiruluta UC Berkeley, School of Information
arxiv-2508-03170.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrew Kiruluta UC Berkeley, School of Information. We propose a novel machine learning architecture that departs from conventional neural network paradigms by leveraging quantum spectral methods, specifically Padé approximants and the Lanczos algorithm, for interpretable signal analysis and symbolic reasoning. The core innovation of our approach lies in its ability to transform raw time-domain signals into sparse, physically meaningful spectral representations without the use of backpropagation, high-dimensional embeddings, or data-hungry black-box models.

arxiv-2509-06235.title: PillagerBench: Benchmarking LLM-Based Agents in Competitive Minecraft Team Environments
arxiv-2509-06235.creator: Olivier Schipper 1 Yudi Zhang 1 Yali Du 2 Mykola Pechenizkiy 1 Meng Fang 3,1
arxiv-2509-06235.description: Abstract LLM-based agents have shown promise in various cooperative and strategic reasoning tasks, but their effectiveness in competitive multi-agent environments remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PillagerBench, a novel framework for evaluating multi-agent systems in real-time competitive team-vs-team scenarios in Minecraft. It provides an extensible API, multi-round testing, and rule-based built-in opponents for fair, reproducible comparisons.

pmc-11631340.description: Learning global structures, i.e. topological properties, inherent in complex data is an essential yet challenging task that spans across various scientific and engineering disciplines. pmc-11725089.title: Updates on the clinical application of glass ionomer cement in restorative and preventive dentistry
pmc-11725089.creator: Kelsey Xingyun Ge, Walter Yu-Hang Lam, Chun-Hung Chu, Ollie Yiru Yu
pmc-11725089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The World Health Organization (WHO) has added glass ionomer cement (GIC) to the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines since 2021, which represents the most efficacious, safe and cost-effective medicines for priority conditions. With the potential increase in the use of GIC, this review aims to provide an overview of the clinical application of GIC with updated evidence in restorative and preventive dentistry.

Fibrous dysplasia may rarely present with predominant gingival involvement and minimal radiographic evidence of intraosseous disease.
